2014-00-105-0001
Civil and Session
Courts
(Establishment and
Committed
Expenditure)
column7:
Augmentation in provision of
₹2,194.01 lakh was the net
effect of increase of
₹4,495.60 lakh and decrease
by re-appropriation of
₹2,301.59 lakh. Increase was
attributed to need of
additional amounts in special
pay and other allowance,
hospitality expense,
telephone, contract service,
maintenanceand repairs, van,
medical reimbursement and
commercial/arts/technical
services. Decrease was
attributed to anticipated
saving. Final saving of
₹11,622.08 lakh is
understated by ₹260.03 lakh
due to clearance of OB
Suspense related to previous
years. Reasons for actual final
saving of ₹11,882.11 lakh
have not been intimated (July
2025).
